name: Jorah GitHub
description: Clone and sync Adam's repos, push a jorah/* branch from ~/work and open a draft pull request. Push and pull request wait for Adam's approval and a live check of the repo's rulesets. Uses the jorah-bot GitHub App; its key and tokens never reach the sandbox or the work repo.

owner.description: GitHub account whose repos Jorah may clone and work on; the folder name under workDir is the repo name

repos.description: Optional: project folder name under workDir -> owner/repo, for a folder named differently from its repo

projectsRegistry.description: The project runner's registry, read for a project's level and pause (default /home/jorah/.config/jorah-projects/projects.json)

projectsStateDir.description: The project runner's state, read for its push block and clean head; pushes.jsonl is written here (default /home/jorah/.jorah-projects)

standingGrant.description: Level 2's standing push grant (issue #19): a level-2 project's jorah/ push skips the card when every check passes. Off until Adam's written yes after the P5 guard review and a week at level 1 without incident. Only true turns it on

guardStateDir.description: jorah-guard's state folder, read only for its FROZEN file (default /home/jorah/.jorah-guard)

selfRepos.description: Repo names whose pushes always ask, whatever the grant (default ["jorah"])
